	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c1 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c2 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c3 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c4 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c5 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c6 } } }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = LR_pk_draw min = 0 max = 52 integer = yes }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = LR_pk_draw min = 0 max = 51 }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = LR_pk_draw min = 0 max = 51 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_c7 = LR_pk_draw }
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = LR_pk_draw min = 0 max = 52 integer = yes }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c1 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c2 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c3 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c4 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c5 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c6 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c7 } } }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = LR_pk_draw min = 0 max = 52 integer = yes }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = LR_pk_draw min = 0 max = 51 }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = LR_pk_draw min = 0 max = 51 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_c8 = LR_pk_draw }
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = LR_pk_draw min = 0 max = 52 integer = yes }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c1 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c2 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c3 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c4 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c5 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c6 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c7 } check_variable = { LR_pk_draw = LR_pk_c8 } } }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = LR_pk_draw min = 0 max = 52 integer = yes }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = LR_pk_draw min = 0 max = 51 }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = LR_pk_draw min = 0 max = 51 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_c9 = LR_pk_draw }
}

lr_pk_show = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_pk_seen > 0 } }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_f1 = LR_pk_c1 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pk_f1 = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { LR_pk_f1 = 53 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_pk_seen > 0 } }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_f2 = LR_pk_c2 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pk_f2 = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { LR_pk_f2 = 53 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_pk_seen > 1 } }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_f3 = LR_pk_c3 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pk_f3 = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { LR_pk_f3 = 53 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_pk_seen > 1 } }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_f4 = LR_pk_c4 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pk_f4 = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { LR_pk_f4 = 53 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_pk_seen > 1 } }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_f5 = LR_pk_c5 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pk_f5 = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { LR_pk_f5 = 53 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_pk_seen > 2 } }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_f6 = LR_pk_c6 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pk_f6 = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { LR_pk_f6 = 53 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_pk_seen > 3 } }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_f7 = LR_pk_c7 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pk_f7 = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { LR_pk_f7 = 53 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_pk_stage = 5 } }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_f8 = LR_pk_c8 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pk_f8 = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { LR_pk_f8 = 53 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_pk_stage = 5 } }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_f9 = LR_pk_c9 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pk_f9 = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { LR_pk_f9 = 53 } }
}

lr_pk_showdown = {
	set_variable = { LR_ev_1 = LR_pk_c1 }
	set_variable = { LR_ev_2 = LR_pk_c2 }
	set_variable = { LR_ev_3 = LR_pk_c3 }
	set_variable = { LR_ev_4 = LR_pk_c4 }
	set_variable = { LR_ev_5 = LR_pk_c5 }
	set_variable = { LR_ev_6 = LR_pk_c6 }
	set_variable = { LR_ev_7 = LR_pk_c7 }
	lr_pk_eval = yes
	set_variable = { LR_pk_pscore = LR_ev_score }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_pcat = LR_ev_cat }
	set_variable = { LR_ev_1 = LR_pk_c8 }
	set_variable = { LR_ev_2 = LR_pk_c9 }
	set_variable = { LR_ev_3 = LR_pk_c3 }
	set_variable = { LR_ev_4 = LR_pk_c4 }
	set_variable = { LR_ev_5 = LR_pk_c5 }
	set_variable = { LR_ev_6 = LR_pk_c6 }
	set_variable = { LR_ev_7 = LR_pk_c7 }
	lr_pk_eval = yes
	set_variable = { LR_pk_oscore = LR_ev_score }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_ocat = LR_ev_cat }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_pk_pscore > LR_pk_oscore } }
		add_to_variable = { LR_funds = LR_pk_pot }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_res = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_pk_pscore < LR_pk_oscore } }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_res = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		divide_variable = { LR_pk_pot = 2 }
		round_variable = LR_pk_pot
		add_to_variable = { LR_funds = LR_pk_pot }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_res = 3 }
	}
	set_variable = { LR_pk_pot = 0 }
}

lr_pk_init = {
	set_variable = { LR_pk_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_seen = 0 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_pot = 0 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_res = 0 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_pcat = 0 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_ocat = 0 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_f1 = 53 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_f2 = 53 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_f3 = 53 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_f4 = 53 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_f5 = 53 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_f6 = 53 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_f7 = 53 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_f8 = 53 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_f9 = 53 }
}

lr_pk_bet = {
	set_temp_variable = { LR_pk_r8 = LR_pk_c8 }
	modulo_temp_variable = { LR_pk_r8 = 13 }
	set_temp_variable = { LR_pk_r9 = LR_pk_c9 }
	modulo_temp_variable = { LR_pk_r9 = 13 }
	set_temp_variable = { LR_pk_odds = 8 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { LR_pk_r8 < 8 }
			check_variable = { LR_pk_r9 < 8 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { LR_pk_r8 = LR_pk_r9 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { LR_pk_odds = 45 }
	}
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = LR_pk_roll min = 0 max = 100 integer = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_pk_roll < LR_pk_odds } }
		add_to_variable = { LR_funds = LR_pk_pot }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_pot = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_stage = 7 }
		set_variable = { LR_pk_res = 5 }
		lr_pk_show = yes
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { LR_funds = -20 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pk_pot = 40 }
		lr_pk_advance = yes
	}
}

lr_pk_advance = {
	add_to_variable = { LR_pk_stage = 1 }
	set_variable = { LR_pk_seen = LR_pk_stage }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_pk_stage = 5 } }
		lr_pk_showdown = yes
	}
	lr_pk_show = yes
}
